opportunities.title: Gnomecast Says Scheduling Is 'The Greatest Foe' — Here's the Ruleset Nobody Codified Yet
opportunities.why_now: Gnome Stew's fresh episode tackles the most common (and least systematized) TTRPG problem, giving us a direct hook to formalize scheduling as a rules problem.
opportunities.angle: Response essay that extracts a concrete 'house rules' framework for session scheduling, citing and building on the podcast's points

opportunities.title: Attack on Titan 3's New 'Focus Mode' Is Basically a Reaction Mechanic — What TTRPGs Got Right First

opportunities.title: Obsidian Now Answers to Bethesda — What Happens to the Pillars of Eternity Ruleset?
